examples.name: Small page count (no ellipsis)
examples.description: Every page fits within the default sibling/boundary window.

examples.name: Middle of a large range
examples.description: Ellipses appear on both sides of the current page.

examples.name: Wider sibling range
examples.description: Raising siblingCount shows more pages around the current one, closer to Figma's wide-container sample.

examples.name: Custom accessible labels
examples.jsx:
<Pagination
  currentPage={2}
  totalPages={10}
  onPageChange={setPage}
  ariaLabel="Search results pages"
  previousLabel="Previous results"
  nextLabel="Next results"
/>

antiExamples.name: Single page
antiExamples.reason: Pagination adds navigation overhead with nothing to navigate to - omit it when there's only one page.

antiExamples.name: Infinite scroll content
antiExamples.reason: Pagination expects a known, finite totalPages - use a 'load more' affordance for infinite scroll instead.
